set.body:
Purpose

Use realistic scientific workflows to prove that the semantic and policy foundations are usable rather than merely well typed.

Phase acceptance criteria

- [ ] One conceptual trial can lower to multiple phases while retaining parent trial identity, phase identity, factors, modulators, run identity, and original-row provenance.
- [ ] The DMS scenario constructs exactly 50 task columns with the declared structural origins and no manual table explosion, column offsets, or name parsing.
- [ ] DMS hypotheses cover sample response difference, delay load trend, probe mismatch, interaction, RT slope, basis omnibus, FIR omnibus, and a deliberately non-estimable case.
- [ ] A mixed sustained/transient scenario covers blocks, cues, errors or feedback, variable epochs, and phase-specific HRFs.
- [ ] A realistic nuisance scenario exercises motion-derived terms, CompCor-like components, spikes, constants, and near collinearity.
- [ ] A public AR scenario proves that whitening never crosses runs or censor gaps.
- [ ] All scenarios return one clean ScenarioResult and use only published/public module surfaces on both platforms.
set.title: Phase 3: prove flagship multiphase and realistic first-level workflows
